subject: SOC 2 supplemental evidence: MFA enrollment matrix & KMS rotation traces
messages:
From: Jae Kim <jae.kim@somahealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: AuditLane <audits@auditlane.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 artifacts & bridge letter — scope and timeline

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for taking this on. SomaHealth is finalizing our vendor security review and the audit team asked for a few artifacts to validate controls that aren't fully covered by the SOC 2 Type II report we received. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the following as separate CSV / log slices (not just screenshots) for the audit scope Jan 1, 2026 — Jun 30, 2026?

- MFA enrollment matrix (list of users, device type, enrollment timestamp, method)
- KMS/keystore rotation traces (rotation events, key IDs, operator identities, timestamps)
- Admin access review attestations and the access review spreadsheet for privileged accounts
- A short bridge letter that calls out any exceptions or changes since the SOC 2 window

If possible, we need deliverables by Nov 10 to meet our internal audit cutoff. If you require a narrow user scope or a PO reference, our procurement reference is SOMA-PO-453. Also looping in AuditLane (cc) — they'd like native CSV/JSON extracts for sampling.

Are any of these items considered sensitive to share as raw logs? If so, let us know the suggested redaction/transfer mechanism (S3 presign, secure share, NDA amendment).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to jump on a 20-minute call if that helps.

Best,
Jae
Jae Kim
Senior Procurement Manager
SomaHealth
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Jae Kim <jae.kim@somahealth.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, AuditLane <audits@auditlane.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 artifacts & bridge letter — scope and timeline

Jae — thanks for the precise ask and the cutoff. Looping in Olga (security) and Laura (compliance) to scope the extracts and confirm transfer mechanics. Preliminary answers below: 

- MFA enrollment matrix: we can provide a CSV with user_id, directory_email, enrollment_method, enrollment_ts, and device_type. We will need a list of user prefixes/tenant IDs to limit the export (we do org-wide logs by default).
- KMS rotation traces: we can produce an audit slice (rotation events + operator + key-id + previous_key_digest + timestamp). Full raw logs are sensitive; we typically provide redacted slices or presigned S3 manifests.
- Admin access review: we can export the attestation spreadsheet and provide a signed PDF attestation from the control owner.
- Bridge letter: compliance can draft a short letter that summarizes the audit window and any control changes.

Olga/Laura — can you confirm estimated delivery dates if we target Nov 12 (two business days after the cutoff Jae mentioned) for the CSV slices and the bridge letter? Also advise on whether AuditLane needs a sample list of user ids or we should propose a minimal scope.

Attaching an evidence manifest template (see attachment) — please use it when replying with your requested scope.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Head of Sales (Security & Strategic Accounts)
Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Jae Kim <jae.kim@somahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, AuditLane <audits@auditlane.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 artifacts & bridge letter — scope and timeline

Hi all — quick technical clarifications and our recommended delivery plan.

Scope narrowing (recommended): please provide either (a) a list of SomaHealth user email prefixes (e.g. @somahealth.com) or (b) a list of 50 sample user IDs for sampling. This keeps exports small and avoids disclosing other customers.

Artifact formats and redaction: we will provide:
- MFA_enrollment_slice.csv (columns: user_id, email, method, device_type, enrolled_at) — PII is limited to emails; we can pseudonymize if required by procurement.
- KMS_rotation_slice.jsonl.gz (per-event lines) and a summarized CSV with operator, key_id, rotation_ts, previous_thumbprint. Full raw KMS audit streams will only be provided as a presigned S3 bundle with time-limited access; raw bundles require a signed Data Transfer Agreement (we can use our standard DTA).
- Admin_access_review.xlsx and Admin_Attestation.pdf signed by the control owner.
- Bridge_Letter.pdf (one page) covering audit window, any control changes since report, and references to the artifacts delivered.

Delivery timeline (target):
- Nov 5: confirm scope (user list or prefix) and sign DTA if raw logs needed
- Nov 9: deliver preliminary CSV slices (MFA + KMS summary) via secure share
- Nov 12: deliver presigned S3 bundle (if requested) + Bridge_Letter.pdf + Admin_Attestation.pdf

Security notes: if AuditLane requests raw logs containing full IP addresses or device fingerprints we will redact those fields unless SomaHealth provides a formal legal basis for retention.

Attachments: evidence_manifest_template.csv (please return with selected scope), requested_scope_list.csv (optional sample).

If that timeline works for SomaHealth, we will proceed. If you need an earlier snapshot or a narrower window, advise and we can accelerate for a specific date range.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Jae Kim <jae.kim@somahealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, AuditLane <audits@auditlane.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 15:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 artifacts & bridge letter — scope and timeline

Hi Olga / Nikhil — thanks for the clear plan and the template. SomaHealth confirms the following:

- Scope: all users with email suffix @somahealth.com (approx. 142 accounts)
- We will sign the DTA for the presigned S3 bundle if raw KMS rotation events are required.
- Procurement reference SOMA-PO-453 included.
- Delivery acceptance: CSV slices + Bridge_Letter.pdf + Admin_Attestation.pdf by Nov 12 is acceptable.

AuditLane — please reply if you need additional fields in the CSVs for sampling (e.g., device_fingerprint, ip_address). If redaction is unavoidable please advise minimal requirements.

Appreciate the responsiveness. We'll await the secure share.

Best,
Jae Kim
Senior Procurement Manager
SomaHealth
